events.text: SGX is committing to a 42% reduction in Scope 2 emissions by FY2031 from the base as at FY2021, pledging to set science-based emissions reduction targets consistent with keeping global warming to 1.5°C.
From the 2025 financial year onwards, Singapore-listed companies must report their scope 1 and scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions.
Singapore Exchange added a rule requiring an issuer to issue a sustainability report on 20 July 2016, amended on 1 January 2022 and 1 January 2026.
Since 2016, the Singapore Exchange has required every listed issuer to prepare an annual sustainability report.
From FY 2025 onwards, the Singapore Exchange requires all listed issuers to publish climate-related disclosures aligned with the International Sustainability Standards Board framework.
The 2026 enhanced requirements introduce more rigorous climate disclosure obligations aligned with international best practices.
